BFA.note: DenonciationPro takes reports of dysfunctions and wrongdoing, not views on policy or law.

facts.fact: The Commission de Régulation des Dysfonctionnements launched the DenonciationPro online platform, announced 23 February 2026, for citizens to report confidentially dysfunctions in public administration in about five minutes.

BFA.note: Nothing on consultation of outside parties on a digital law or policy.
